Priyanka Pillai
Senior QA Automation Engineer | Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra
priyanka.pillai856@example.com | +91 9468249351

Experienced QA Automation Engineer specializing in designing and delivering reliable automated test suites for consumer-facing applications. Strong focus on reducing regression cycles, increasing CI throughput, and improving release confidence through automation and test strategy. Open to opportunities; notice period: 15 days.

Experience

Swiggy — Jan 2025 - Present
Senior QA Automation Engineer (Hybrid)
- Designed and implemented end-to-end automation frameworks using Java and TestNG, reducing manual regression time by 65% and cutting release verification from 24 hours to under 6 hours.
- Built Playwright-based UI checks for the ordering and payments flows, catching 18 critical production issues during the first three months and improving customer success KPIs.
- Integrated TestNG suites into CI pipelines and streamlined test reporting in Confluence, enabling cross-team visibility and reducing triage time by 40%.

Paystack India — Jun 2020 - Dec 2024
QA Automation Engineer (Remote)
- Developed and maintained Selenium and Playwright automation suites for payments and reconciliation services, increasing automated coverage for core flows to 78%.
- Created API test collections in Postman and automated execution via Jenkins pipelines, enabling nightly regression runs that reduced post-deploy incidents by 50%.
- Collaborated with engineering to parameterize tests and implement flaky test handling, improving CI stability and decreasing false positives by 70%.
- Authored Confluence runbooks and troubleshooting guides for QA processes, shortening onboarding ramp for new testers by two weeks.

Projects
- Payments Resilience Suite: Led a side project to build a Postman + Jenkins pipeline that simulated failure modes for payment gateways, surfacing edge cases and reducing payment retry rates in staging by 22%.
- UI Smoke Dashboard: Implemented a Playwright-based smoke dashboard that runs against canary builds and publishes results to Confluence, enabling faster go/no-go decisions.
